01About

I did not start in marketing. I worked on an alpaca ranch, then cooked for a sorority house, then started as an SEO intern at Upgrow, a marketing agency for B2B software companies, with no marketing experience at all.

I learned SEO and conversion tracking on the job, asked to learn paid search, and kept getting pulled toward the question behind every campaign: can we trust this number? That question is now my job.

I studied applied mathematics at UC San Diego. Outside work I shoot photos and write screenplays.

02What I do at work

Client work stays private, so this is the shape of it with no names and no numbers. The projects below rebuild the same kind of work in public.

  • Conversion tracking

    Tag Manager and GA4 setups, consent, and finding out why a conversion stopped firing. Looker Studio dashboards on top.

  • CRM to ad platforms

    Mapping CRM stages from Salesforce and HubSpot back to Google Ads and LinkedIn as offline conversions, so bidding can learn from more than form fills.

  • Paid search and SEO

    Hands-on campaign work in Google Ads, Microsoft Ads and LinkedIn Ads, plus SEO. It is where I started and why I care about the data.

  • AI automation

    Internal tools built with Claude Code. Code does the math, the model writes the words, and a person approves before anything goes out.

03How I work

  • Code computes, the model narrates.

    All the math lives in tested code. AI only writes the words around it.

  • Never guess at a cause.

    Check the logs first.

  • Keep it simple.

    A tool has to work for someone with no technical background, and anyone should be able to take it over.

  • Good enough is good enough.

    Small, lean and shipped beats one big thing that does too much at once.
